import copy, json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from crosscheck.crosscheck import StreamEngine

FAILS = []
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAILS.append(name); print('FAIL', name); print('  got ', json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True)[:600]); print('  want', json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True)[:600])
    else:
        print('pass', name)

TOPO = {"nodes": [{"id": 0, "name": "A", "external_capacity": 1000},
                  {"id": 1, "name": "B", "external_capacity": 1000},
                  {"id": 2, "name": "C", "external_capacity": 1000}],
        "links": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "capacity": 10},
                  {"source": 1, "target": 2, "capacity": 10}],
        "external_nodes": ["A", "B", "C"]}
SETTINGS = {"trials": 4, "epsilon": 0, "seed": 9, "cutoff": [0, 1], "bias": 0, "tau": 0,
            "gamma": [1, 1], "cache_slots": 2}
PLAN = {"A": {"B": [{"path": ["A", "B"], "weight": 1000}],
              "C": [{"path": ["A", "B", "C"], "weight": 600}, {"path": ["A", "B", "C"], "weight": 400}]},
        "B": {"A": [{"path": ["B", "A"], "weight": 1000}],
              "C": [{"path": ["B", "C"], "weight": 1000}]},
        "C": {"A": [{"path": ["C", "B", "A"], "weight": 1000}],
              "B": [{"path": ["C", "B"], "weight": 1000}]}}

def run(events, settings=None, topology=None):
    stream = {"topology": copy.deepcopy(topology or TOPO),
              "settings": copy.deepcopy(settings or SETTINGS), "events": events}
    return StreamEngine(stream).replay(events)

def test_floor_and_repeats():
    events = [{"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 3], [0, 2, 7]], "counters": {}},
              {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": PLAN},
              {"op": "repair", "id": "f"}, {"op": "validate", "id": "f"}]
    answers = run(events)
    links = {tuple(link[:2]): link[2:] for link in answers[2]['links']}
    # hop (A,B) carries 3*1000 + 7*600 + 7*400 = 10000 -> floor 10, at capacity
    check('repeat weights accumulate before floor', links[(0, 1)][0], 10)
    check('downstream hop', links[(1, 2)][0], 7)
    # validation expectation is unclamped: 10 vs 10 passes here
    check('validate passes', answers[3]['passed'], answers[3]['checked'])

def test_excessive_demand_detected():
    events = [{"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 900]], "counters": {}},
              {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": PLAN},
              {"op": "repair", "id": "x"}, {"op": "validate", "id": "x"}]
    answers = run(events)
    links = {tuple(link[:2]): link[2:] for link in answers[2]['links']}
    check('clamped repair vote', links[(0, 1)][0], 10)
    check('clamped origination', links[(-1, 0)][0], 10)
    check('external marginal unclamped in validation', answers[3]['checked'] > 0, True)
    check('excessive demand fails', answers[3]['failed'],
          ['low_A_egress_to_B', 'low_A_origination', 'low_A_termination', 'low_B_ingress_from_A',
           'low_B_termination', 'low_C_ingress_from_B', 'low_C_termination', 'low_B_egress_to_A',
           'low_B_origination', 'low_C_origination'])
    print('validate', answers[3])

def test_empty_plan():
    topology = {"nodes": [{"id": 0, "name": "A", "external_capacity": 5}], "links": [],
                "external_nodes": []}
    events = [{"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": {}},
              {"op": "repair", "id": "e"}, {"op": "validate", "id": "e"}]
    answers = run(events, topology=topology)
    check('no flows publication', (answers[1]['links'], answers[1]['order'], answers[1]['counters']),
          ([], [], {}))
    check('no eligible checks', answers[2], {"op": "validate", "id": "e", "checked": 0, "passed": 0,
                                             "consistent": None, "failed": []})

def test_null_paths_marginals():
    events = [{"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 2, 5], [2, 1, 4]], "counters": {}},
              {"op": "repair", "id": "n"}, {"op": "validate", "id": "n"}]
    answers = run(events)
    links = {tuple(link[:2]): link[2:] for link in answers[1]['links']}
    check('origination marginal', links[(-1, 0)][0], 5)
    check('termination marginal', links[(2, -1)][0], 4)
    check('null paths check only externals', answers[2]['checked'], 6)
    check('marginals agree', answers[2]['passed'], 6)

def main():
    test_floor_and_repeats()
    test_excessive_demand_detected()
    test_empty_plan()
    test_null_paths_marginals()
    print('failures', FAILS)
    return 1 if FAILS else 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
